comment: Continuance of 1st semester. Pretty boring. Long (5hr) take home, open note exam at end (start early- save your labs from the semester). Class only lasts 2/3 of semester. Very helpful and nice in office hours. Class was about once a week for 50 minutes. Understands the class is boring for us, but tries to make it interesting and lets you out early.

Legal Research sucks in general. Class is 50 minutes once a week. Good thing they taper off as the semester continues. Full year class. Corriell is super helpful, clear, and passionate about her topic. She knows the class doesn't really care and tries to make jokes. This class could be worse; she makes it manageable.
